provider: ZeroEntropy zerank reranker and zembed-1 embeddings API

free_tier.stated: none: the vendor sunset its hosted products after September 4th, 2026 and disabled new signups; the FAQ still advertises a free tier of unstated size. The models are released as open weights under Apache 2.0

tooling: Python and TypeScript SDKs and a REST API that no longer serve; the open weights of zerank-1, zerank-2 and zembed-1 are on Hugging Face
chaining: none: the hosted API is down

limits.value: while the API served: 500,000 bytes and 1,000 requests per minute by default per the rerank reference, 2,500,000 UTF-8 bytes per minute per the pricing page; the endpoint now answers HTTP 503

identity_cost.detail: new signups are disabled; unverified: the former sign-up fields, because the dashboard page shows a marketing shell only

reliability_note: the hosted rerank endpoint answered HTTP 503 with the body 'ZeroEntropy inference is unavailable.' on 2026-11-03, after the vendor's announced sunset of 2026-09-04; the docs, FAQ and pricing pages still list prices and a free tier
confidence_note: the sunset notice is quoted from the vendor and the 503 is a stored probe of the endpoint.
